text: {"memo": "NVDA’s FY2025 performance shows robust top‑line growth, with revenue reaching $130.50\u202fbillion, more than double the $60.92\u202fbillion recorded in FY2024. The company\u2019s profitability expanded sharply, delivering net income of $72.88\u202fbillion versus $29.76\u202fbillion in the prior year, and operating income of $81.45\u202fbillion compared with $32.97\u202fbillion. Diluted EPS rose to $2.94 per share from $1.19, reflecting strong earnings leverage. Operating cash flow more than doubled to $64.09\u202fbillion from $28.09\u202fbillion, underscoring healthy cash generation. The margin improvement across net income and operating income highlights the effectiveness of the AI\u2011driven data\u2011center strategy and the scaling of the graphics pipeline. FY2025\u2019s cash flow position provides ample flexibility for continued R&D, strategic acquisitions, and shareholder returns. Overall, NVDA demonstrates a powerful acceleration in both revenue and profitability, positioning it well for sustained growth. View: Buy."}
